title: Mapping simplex as a pushout attaching the last fiber
statement:
Use small simplicial sets and standard simplices of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and colimits of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $n>0$ and let $A_0\leftarrow\cdots\leftarrow A_n$ be any chain of small simplicial sets, with composites $t_{j,i}:A_j\to A_i$. Define the mapping simplex by $M(A)_r=\coprod_{\alpha:[r]\to[n]}(A_{\alpha(r)})_r$ and operators $(\alpha,a)\mapsto(\alpha\theta,t_{\alpha(r),\alpha\theta(s)}\theta^*a)$ for $\theta:[s]\to[r]$. Define $M_-=M(A_0\leftarrow\cdots\leftarrow A_{n-1})$ by the same formula, and let $T=\Delta^{\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}\subseteq\Delta^n$. Define $g:A_n\times T\to M_-$ in degree $r$ by $g(a,\alpha)=(\alpha,t_{n,\alpha(r)}a)$, and $h:A_n\times\Delta^n\to M(A)$ by $h(a,\alpha)=(\alpha,t_{n,\alpha(r)}a)$. Together with the inclusion $M_-\hookrightarrow M(A)$ these maps induce a canonical isomorphism of simplicial sets
$$M_-\amalg_{A_n\times T}(A_n\times\Delta^n)\ \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\ M(A).$$
It respects the maps to $\Delta^n$ and is natural for maps of chains that commute with all transitions. No injectivity or fibrancy hypothesis on the chain is required.

Read online 2026-10-17. WANTED: archival copy under literature/. No Stacks tag states this simplicial result.
